preparation_lessons.title: Explore demand with a bounded reservation test
preparation_lessons.approach: Offer a small, clearly scoped reservation experiment. Record requests, cancellations, constraints and a decision to continue, change or stop.
preparation_lessons.interpretation: An original illustrative learning prompt, not a conclusion drawn from real startup history.
preparation_lessons.caution: Fictional scenario: no observed outcome, survival evidence or predictive value. Choose your own scope and decision criteria.
